filer_name.description: Registrant name (e.g., 'VANGUARD INDEX FUNDS'). The legal entity that files; one CIK can host multiple Series.

filer_lei.description: Registrant LEI, 20 hex characters (Legal Entity Identifier). 'N/A' is a valid value when the registrant has no LEI.

series_id.description: SEC-assigned Series identifier of the form Sxxxxxxxxx (10 chars). One Registrant can host many Series; this disambiguates the specific fund.

series_name.description: Human-readable name of the Series, e.g. 'VANGUARD TOTAL STOCK MARKET INDEX FUND'.

fund_lei.description: LEI of the Series (the actual fund).

report_period_end.description: Period of report, ISO date YYYY-MM-DD. Always a fiscal-quarter-end date because only the third month of each fiscal quarter is publicly disseminated.

total_assets_usd.description: Total fund assets in USD, as a non-negative decimal.

total_liabilities_usd.description: Total fund liabilities in USD. Output null when the cover page does not state this.

net_assets_usd.description: Total fund net assets in USD (assets minus liabilities).

holdings.description: Schedule of investments: every position held by the fund as of report_period_end. Order is filer-defined and not significant for grading.

issuer_name.description: Issuer of the security. Verbatim as filed (e.g. 'Surgery Partners Inc').

issuer_lei.description: Issuer LEI (20 chars) or 'N/A'. Required to be present in the XML even if 'N/A'.

security_title.description: Title of the issue, e.g. 'SURGERY PARTNERS' or 'TREASURY BILL 01/26 0.00000'. May differ from issuer_name (e.g. issuer 'United States Govt' / title 'Treasury Bill ...').

cusip.description: 9-character CUSIP, uppercase. 'N/A' is permitted (foreign issuers without CUSIP). Compare case-insensitively.

isin.description: 12-character ISIN if present in the identifiers block. Optional alternative when CUSIP is 'N/A'.

ticker.description: Equity ticker if present in the identifiers block.

balance.description: Position size as a decimal. Interpreted via units: NS=number of shares, PA=principal amount, OU=other units.

units.description: NS=number of shares, PA=principal amount, OU=other units (then descOthUnits is set). Equity positions almost always NS; debt almost always PA.

currency_code.description: ISO 4217 currency code of the position (USD, EUR, GBP, ...). Most fund holdings are reported in USD even when the underlying is foreign-denominated; non-USD positions also carry an exchange rate. Output null when the row does not state a currency code.

value_usd.description: Position value in USD, decimal. PDF rendering may show with $ and commas; comparator must normalize.

percent_of_net_assets.description: Percent of net assets, stored as a percent value (not a fraction). E.g. 1.156308 means 1.156% (filer's $15.26M position in $1.32B net assets). Filers report to 4-6 decimals; tiny positions can read like 0.001840 = 0.0018%.

asset_category.description: Asset class. EC=equity-common, EP=equity-preferred, DBT=debt, ABS=asset-backed, STIV=short-term investment vehicle, RA=repurchase agreement, etc. Most enterprise-relevant filings will see EC, DBT, STIV, ABS predominantly.

issuer_category.description: Issuer class (CORP, MUN, USGSE, UST, RF, PF, OTHER). May be empty for certain instrument types.

investment_country.description: ISO country code of the investment (US, GB, JP, ...).

fair_value_level.description: US GAAP ASC 820 fair-value hierarchy. 1=quoted-active-market, 2=other-observable, 3=unobservable, N/A=not applicable.
